hero.title: Are Ritz-Carlton Yacht Shore Excursions Included?
hero.subtitle: Shore excursions are generally not included in standard fares. Learn what the all-inclusive cruise fare covers, excursion pricing models, private tour options, booking timelines, and total trip budgeting.

executivePhilosophy.title: Onboard All-Inclusive Luxury with Bespoke Ashore Flexibility
executivePhilosophy.highlight: SHORE EXCURSIONS ARE AN ADDITIONAL EXPENSE
paragraphs: Are Ritz-Carlton Yacht shore excursions included? No. Shore excursions are generally not included in the standard Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection cruise fare. The yachts offer an all-inclusive onboard experience that includes accommodations, dining, beverages, standard Wi-Fi, onboard gratuities, and other amenities, but shore excursions are an additional expense.

The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection offers several types of shore experiences, including Select Group Excursions, Pre-Designed Private Excursions, and Custom Private Excursions. These experiences can be reserved before sailing and are priced separately from the cruise fare.
If you are comparing Ritz-Carlton Yacht pricing with other luxury cruise lines, understanding what is and is not included in the fare is essential for building an accurate vacation budget.
executivePhilosophy.quote: The cruise line uses the term all-inclusive for its onboard experience, but its booking terms specifically separate onboard inclusions from optional shore experiences.

coreDistinctionAuthority.title: DOES RITZ-CARLTON YACHT INCLUDE SHORE EXCURSIONS?
coreDistinctionAuthority.text: No. Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection does not generally include shore excursions in its cruise fare. The cruise fare covers many onboard elements, including suite accommodations, meals, selected beverages, entertainment, standard Wi-Fi, and onboard gratuities. Shore excursions, sightseeing and certain ashore expenses are separately charged. This distinction matters because Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection uses the term all-inclusive for its onboard experience. A traveler could reasonably assume that every activity, including tours in port, is included. However, the cruise line's terms make a clear distinction between onboard inclusions and optional shore experiences.

freeExcursionsNote.text: Standard Ritz-Carlton Yacht fares do not generally include complimentary shore excursions. While occasional promotional offers, onboard credits, or Virtuoso travel advisor amenities may offset costs, travelers should always calculate total trip cost including the specific tours they want to experience.

gratuitiesSection.text: Onboard crew gratuities (housekeeping, dining staff, bartenders, suite attendants) are 100% included in the Ritz-Carlton cruise fare. However, gratuities for local tour guides and motorcoach drivers ashore are NOT included in the cruise fare and may be extended voluntarily at your discretion (typically $5–$10 per person for guides, $2–$5 for drivers).

fifteenQuestionsChecklist.title: 15 Crucial Questions to Ask Before Booking a Shore Excursion
fifteenQuestionsChecklist.subtitle: Review these key parameters with your travel advisor before confirming any shore experience.

cards.title: Logistics, Inclusions & Pacing
items: 1. Is this a small-group tour or a private vehicle experience?
2. What is exactly included in the tour price (guide, transport, food, admissions)?
3. What is the total duration of the excursion and drive time?
4. How much strenuous walking, stairs, or uneven cobblestone terrain is involved?
5. Is private air-conditioned vehicle transportation included?
6. Is lunch, wine tasting, or a snack included during the tour?
7. Are entrance fees and skip-the-line museum tickets included?
8. Are beverages (water, wine, soft drinks) provided on transport?

cards.title: Suitability, Policies & Group Dynamics
items: 9. Is the excursion suitable for children and families?
10. Is the tour appropriate for guests with limited mobility or wheelchair needs?
11. What is the weather cancellation policy if rain occurs?
12. What is the cancellation deadline for full refund (group vs. private)?
13. Are gratuities for local guides and drivers included or voluntary?
14. What is the maximum group size permitted on this specific tour?
15. How much unstructured free time is allocated for shopping and exploring?

returnGuarantee.title: DO RITZ-CARLTON YACHT EXCURSIONS GUARANTEE RETURN TO THE YACHT?
returnGuarantee.text: Yes. When you participate in an official Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection shore excursion (Group, Pre-Designed, or Custom), the shoreside team maintains direct communication with the yacht's bridge. If a tour experiences unexpected traffic delays or mechanical issues, the yacht coordinates departure or arranges transportation to the next port. Independent travelers, conversely, bear full responsibility for returning to the gangway prior to the published all-aboard time.

faqs.question: Are Ritz-Carlton Yacht shore excursions included?
faqs.answer: No. Shore excursions are generally not included in the standard Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection cruise fare. They are optional destination experiences that are purchased separately.

faqs.question: Is Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection all-inclusive?
faqs.answer: Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection describes its voyages as an all-inclusive onboard experience, with all-suite accommodations, multiple dining options, fine beverages, Wi-Fi, onboard gratuities, and marina water toys included. However, shore excursions and certain personal services are additional.

faqs.question: Are Ritz-Carlton Yacht private excursions included?
faqs.answer: No. Pre-Designed Private Excursions and Custom Private Excursions are separately arranged and charged based on vehicle type, guide fees, and itinerary complexity.

faqs.question: Are Ritz-Carlton Yacht group excursions included?
faqs.answer: No. Select Group Excursions are also separate from the cruise fare and carry a per-guest ticket price. They are subject to capacity limitations.

faqs.question: Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht include gratuities?
faqs.answer: Onboard crew gratuities (dining, bar, housekeeping, and suite attendants) are 100% included in the cruise fare. Gratuities for local tour guides and coach drivers ashore are voluntary.

faqs.question: Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht include drinks?
faqs.answer: Yes. The cruise fare includes a generous selection of premium alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, including fine wines, champagnes, spirits, cocktails, and specialty coffees.

faqs.question: Does Ritz-Carlton Yacht include Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: Yes. Standard high-speed Wi-Fi is included throughout the yacht for all guests according to current booking terms. Upgraded streaming packages may be available for an additional fee.

faqs.question: Are port transfers included on Ritz-Carlton Yacht?
faqs.answer: Complimentary group shuttle transportation is available in select ports between the pier and the town center. This is distinct from private airport transfers, which are separately arranged.

faqs.question: Can I book a private Ritz-Carlton Yacht excursion?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection offers both Pre-Designed Private Excursions (with driver and guide) and fully Custom Private Excursions tailored to your specifications.

faqs.question: When can I book Ritz-Carlton Yacht excursions?
faqs.answer: Guests can arrange Pre-Designed and Custom Private Excursions with shoreside concierges immediately upon booking. Select Group Excursions become available via My Yacht Account approximately 120 days before sailing.

faqs.question: Can I book Ritz-Carlton Yacht excursions onboard?
faqs.answer: Some group excursions may remain available for onboard booking, but inventory is strictly capacity-controlled. Pre-booking is strongly advised for high-demand experiences.

faqs.question: Are Ritz-Carlton Yacht excursions worth the cost?
faqs.answer: Yes, for travelers who appreciate vetted local experts, private transportation, seamless logistics, and VIP access. For guests who simply want to stroll a quaint port, independent exploration is a great alternative.

faqs.question: Are Ritz-Carlton Yacht excursions refundable?
faqs.answer: Cancellation policies vary by excursion type. Group excursions typically permit cancellation up to 48–72 hours prior without penalty, while private and custom experiences have stricter timelines. Always check your specific terms.

faqs.question: Are meals ashore included with Ritz-Carlton Yacht excursions?
faqs.answer: Not automatically. Whether a meal or tasting is included depends on the specific excursion description. Review the detailed itinerary notes prior to booking.

faqs.question: Are Ritz-Carlton Yacht excursions available at every port?
faqs.answer: No. Shore excursion offerings vary by destination, port infrastructure, and local seasonality, and all tours are capacity controlled.

faqs.question: Can a travel advisor help arrange Ritz-Carlton Yacht excursions?
faqs.answer: Yes. A certified luxury travel advisor like Angela Hughes at Trips & Ships can help you evaluate excursion options, coordinate private tours, and integrate them with your flights, hotels, and total trip budget.

finalAnswer.title: Final Answer: Are Ritz-Carlton Yacht Shore Excursions Included?
finalAnswer.lead: No. Ritz-Carlton Yacht shore excursions are generally not included in the standard cruise fare.
paragraphs: The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection provides an extensive all-inclusive onboard experience, but Select Group Excursions, Pre-Designed Private Excursions, and Custom Private Excursions are additional destination experiences purchased separately.

If you are comparing luxury yacht cruises, don't compare only the advertised cruise fare. Consider the complete cost of your trip—including the excursions, private experiences, transfers, and pre- or post-cruise arrangements that matter to you.
For travelers who want a highly personalized luxury yacht vacation, working with an experienced luxury travel advisor can make it easier to evaluate inclusions and build the ideal itinerary.
